title: Rate Manual Page: Manufactured Home Insurance Base Rates and Home-Age Bands
content:
Base rates for Manufactured Home Insurance are annual, quoted per $1,000 of dwelling coverage, before age rating and before discounts.

## Base rate per $1,000 of dwelling coverage

| Policy form | Annual base rate per $1,000 of dwelling coverage |
|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | $6.10 |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | $7.25 |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | $7.40 |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | $8.65 |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | $9.80 |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | $11.20 |

## Home-age rating ladder (all six forms)

The home's age is the rating year less the home's model year, taken on the quote date or the renewal date. The adjustment is the percentage shown for the band that age falls in; a credit lowers the premium and a surcharge raises it.

| Home age band | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 years | 15% credit |
| 6 to 10 years | 8% credit |
| 11 to 20 years | 0% (no adjustment) |
| 21 to 30 years | 10% surcharge |
| 31 to 40 years | 20% surcharge |

The ladder is the same on every form.

## Band boundaries (hypothetical homes rated in 2026)

| Model year | Home age | Band | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 5 years | 0 to 5 | 15% credit |
| 2020 | 6 years | 6 to 10 | 8% credit |
| 2016 | 10 years | 6 to 10 | 8% credit |
| 2015 | 11 years | 11 to 20 | none |
| 2006 | 20 years | 11 to 20 | none |
| 2005 | 21 years | 21 to 30 | 10% surcharge |
| 1996 | 30 years | 21 to 30 | 10% surcharge |
| 1995 | 31 years | 31 to 40 | 20% surcharge |

## Premium rounding

The annual premium of every form is rounded to the nearest whole dollar.
